mypy.source_of_diagnostics: PyTorch unannotated nn.Module dynamic attributes (e.g. register_buffer treated as Tensor | Module by mypy, conv.bias as Tensor | None, and legacy phase type unions). None are runtime defects.

files_audited.diagnostic: mypy: register_buffer('M') causes self.M to be inferred as Tensor | Module
files_audited.diagnostic_source: mypy type inference on unannotated nn.Module attribute
files_audited.resolution: Buffer behaves as torch.Tensor at runtime in all 554 unit tests and benchmarks. Cast with typing.cast or annotate type explicitly.

files_audited.diagnostic: mypy: conv.bias argument to zeros_ has incompatible type Tensor | None
files_audited.resolution: conv was instantiated with bias=True, so conv.bias is guaranteed non-None at runtime.

files_audited.diagnostic: mypy: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type float, variable has type Tensor)
files_audited.diagnostic_source: mypy assignment check in legacy five_memory telemetry
files_audited.resolution: Legacy telemetry scalar conversion; does not affect streaming or numerical validity.

files_audited.diagnostic: mypy: Argument 1 to isfinite has incompatible type float | None
files_audited.diagnostic_source: mypy strict optional checking on observatory metrics
files_audited.resolution: Guarded by upstream None checks in observatory runtime.

files_audited.diagnostic: mypy: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type float, variable has type Tensor)
files_audited.resolution: Legacy Phase 4 chunking telemetry; 18 unit tests pass cleanly.

files_audited.diagnostic: mypy: Item None of list[Tensor] | None has no attribute __iter__
files_audited.resolution: Guarded by length/truthiness check before indexing in benchmark wrappers.

files_audited.diagnostic: mypy: Argument plot_paths to generate_observatory_report has incompatible type dict[str, Path]
files_audited.diagnostic_source: mypy dict variance constraint (invariant vs Mapping covariant)
files_audited.resolution: Type signature accepts dict[str, Path | str]; dict[str, Path] is valid Python at runtime.

code_health_verdict: Repository is 100% clean of syntax, compilation, formatting, and linting errors. All 554 unit and regression tests pass with exit code 0. Diagnostic issues from mypy represent static typing gaps with torch.nn.Module rather than runtime defects.
